#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int N = 1000000 + 7;
const int MOD = 1000000000 + 7;

int p, k;
bool seen[N];
map<int,int> freq;
set<int> lengths;

int cycle_len(int start) {
    int x = start;
    int len = 1;
    while (true) {
        x = (int)(1LL * k * x % p);
        if (x == start) break;
        seen[x] = true;
        ++len;
    }
    return len;
}

long long mod_pow(long long base, int exp) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) res = res * base % MOD;
        base = base * base % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &p, &k);
    if (k == 0) {
        long long ans = 1;
        if (p > 0) ans = mod_pow(p, p - 1);
        printf("%d\n", (int)ans);
        return 0;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
        if (!seen[i]) {
            int len = cycle_len(i);
            ++freq[len];
            lengths.insert(len);
        }
    }

    long long ans = 1;
    for (int L : lengths) {
        long long t = 0;
        for (int d = 1; 1LL * d * d <= L; ++d) {
            if (L % d == 0) {
                int a = L / d;
                int b = d;
                map<int,int>::iterator it = freq.find(a);
                if (it != freq.end()) t += 1LL * a * it->second;
                if (a != b) {
                    it = freq.find(b);
                    if (it != freq.end()) t += 1LL * b * it->second;
                }
                t %= MOD;
            }
        }
        int cnt = freq[L];
        ans = ans * mod_pow(t, cnt) % MOD;
    }

    printf("%d\n", (int)ans);
    return 0;
}

const int N = 1000000 + 7;

int freq[N];

long long power(long long a, int e) {
    long long r = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

int traverse(int st) {
    int x = st;
    int len = 1;
    do {
        x = (int)(1LL * k * x % p);
        if (x == st) break;
        seen[x] = true;
        ++len;
    } while (true);
    return len;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &p, &k);

    if (k == 0) {
        printf("%d\n", (int)power(p, p > 0 ? p - 1 : 0));
        return 0;
    }

        if (!seen[i]) {
            int len = traverse(i);
            ++freq[len];

    long long ans = 1;
    for (int L = 1; L <= p; ++L) {
        if (!freq[L]) continue;
        long long t = 0;
        for (int d = 1; 1LL * d * d <= L; ++d) {
            if (L % d == 0) {
                int a = L / d;
                int b = d;
                t += 1LL * a * freq[a];
                if (a != b) t += 1LL * b * freq[b];
                t %= MOD;
            }
        }
        ans = ans * power(t, freq[L]) % MOD;
    }

    printf("%d\n", (int)ans);
    return 0;
